title: Receipts of Requisition and De-requisition
acceptance_criteria: 18.5.1 After the requisition of each CR asset, system shall auto send the receipt of requisition to CR owner via an email to inform him/her the completion of the asset requisition. He/She shall be able to retrieve the receipts of requisition via the CR Owner Portal.

18.5.2 After the derequisition of each CR asset, system shall auto send the receipt of de- requisition to CR owner via an email to inform him/her the completion of the asset de-requisition. He/She shall be able to retrieve the receipts of de-requisition via the CR Owner Portal.
18.5.3 CR Owner shall be able to view the pertinent details such as Requisition, Derequisition and Compensation amount.

18.5.4 CR Owner shall be able to select the receipts and notify the CRO on matters related to the CR requisition. Upon submitting, owner, system shall send emails to the CRO to inform him/her on the message(s) submitted by the CR owner.
18.5.5 CR Owners shall be able to enquire on compensation payment status.

title: Chatbot
acceptance_criteria: 18.6.1 System shall ensure that upon successful login to the CR Owner Portal, the Chatbot icon/button shall be visible and accessible at all times.
18.6.2 CR owners shall be able to type and submit questions.
18.6.3 System’s chatbot shall display only information that is assigned to that CR owner and not address queries that may provide information/ sensitive details about other CR owners.
18.6.4 System’s chatbot shall display restricted information and shall display appropriate access restriction message when CR owner attempt to ask or retrieve unauthorised data.
18.6.5 System’s chatbot shall be quick in responding (i.e. within a certain timeframe).
18.6.6 System’s chatbot shall provide a fallback response when it cannot understand or answer to a query.
18.6.7 System’s chatbot shall prompt the CR owner to provide or clarify if additional details are required.
18.6.8 In the event that the Chatbot service is unavailable, system shall display an appropriate message informing the CR owner that Chatbot assistance is temporarily unavailable.
18.6.9 System shall ensure that the chat history shall remain available during the CR owner’s active session.
18.6.10 System shall allow administrator to extract chat history for analysis.

title: System Administration for CR owner Portal
acceptance_criteria: 18.7.1 Administrator shall be able to publish information such as downtime message in the CR Owner Portal to inform CR owners of the upcoming system maintenance and downtime.
18.7.2 Administrator shall be able to publish forms that are useful for CR owners, e.g. the latest Application form for Interbank GIRO.
18.7.3 Administrator shall be able to view CR owner’s details uploaded in the CR owner portal.
18.7.4 Administrator shall be able to download all read and acknowledgement activities performed by CR owners.
18.7.5 Administrator shall be able to download the details of the CR owner’s assets. 19. ADMINISTRATOR USER STORY

title: Manage Users
acceptance_criteria: 19.1.1 Administrator shall not be allowed to manage his/her own account.

19.1.2 By default, system shall display the current list of “Active” users, with search function to search users by NRIC number, UserID or Name. There shall be advance filter function to search by appointment, role, email address, and also toggle to display the list “Inactive” users. Fields to be displayed include: NRIC number, UserID, Name, Roles Assigned, Appointment, Ministry/Agency, Unit/Department, Email Address, Date of Last Update. Sort function shall be included.

19.1.3 Administrator shall be able to create new user account. When creating new users, system shall require the Administrator to enter information such as NRIC number, UserID, Full Name, Appointment, Unit/Department, Ministry/Agency, Work email (internet), Role Assignment (main and sub-roles) etc. Certain fields shall require Administrator to select from pre-defined list, such as Ministry/Agency and ReqCens. Option fields shall include “Remarks”, etc. All logins shall be via SingPass and there shall be appropriate validation to check the NRIC number is valid. For MINDEF/SAF users, there shall be an additional layer to valid the NRIC number and UserID exist in EAD/EIMS. System shall log all activities that are related to creating new user account.

19.1.4 Administrator shall be able to add, change and remove the role assignment (main and sub-roles) of an existing user account. He/She shall be able to toggle “Active” and “Inactive” status of the users. For changing the role assignment of an exisiting user account, there shall be a pre-defined list of roles for the Administrator to choose from.
19.1.5 Administrator shall be able to delete an existing user account.
19.1.6 System shall provide an option for Administrator to export the list of users. He/She can select for the output file to be in Excel or PDF format.

title: Manage App Settings
acceptance_criteria: 19.2.1 Administrator shall be able to set the maximum upload file size. There shall be individual setting for Assets, Undertakings and Compensation modules.

19.2.2 Administrator shall be able to set the valid admin upload file extensions such as xls, xlsx, doc, docx, ppt, pptx, pdf, zip, png, jpg, jpeg. There shall be individual setting for Assets, Undertakings and Compensation modules.

19.2.3 Administrator shall be able to set the valid user upload file extensions such as xls, xlsx, doc, docx, ppt, pptx, pdf, zip, png, jpg, jpeg. There shall be individual setting for Assets, Undertakings and Compensation modules.
19.2.4 Administrator shall be able to create a generic error message to show to users if any database exception error happens.
19.2.5 Administrator shall be able to set the maximum number of records/lines to show to users on every list screen.

19.2.6 Administrator shall be able to generate system downtime notices for announcements in CRIPS as well as broadcast via sending auto emails to all CRIPS users. Administrator shall be able to select the mode of announcement/broadcast.

title: Acceptable Use Policy
acceptance_criteria: 19.3.1 On first login, new users shall be prompted the terms and conditions for the use of CRIPS. He/She must review all the terms and conditions before he/she can acknowledge that he/she agree to abide by them. Only upon acknowledging the AUP, he/she can access the CRIPS modules and functions available for him/her.

19.3.2 On an annual basis (to use 1st Jan of each year), all existing users shall be prompted to acknowledge the AUP again. Only upon acknowledging the AUP, he/she can access the CRIPS modules and functions available for him/her.

19.3.3 System shall allow changes to the terms and conditions listed in the AUP. The updates shall be implemented easily, e.g. updates by Administrator or Service Requests. 20. ACCOUNT REVIEWER USER STORY

title: Review Accounts
acceptance_criteria: 20.1.1 System shall generate a task at the start of each month and set the due date for completion to be end of the same month. System shall allow changes in review frequency so as to adhere to the latest policy, e.g. changing review frequency, e.g. from monthly to 3-monthly. System shall allow such changes to be implemented easily, e.g. via changes to site properties.
20.1.2 System shall generate an email to inform Account Reviewer of a task pending his/her action.

20.1.3 System shall categorise the user accounts into “Active Accounts”, “Suspended Accounts” and “Removed Accounts”. When reviewing, system shall display all accounts including the Reviewer’s account. Account Reviewer must not be allowed to review his/her own account. However, his/her account must still be reviewed, i.e. by another Account Reviewer. a. “Active Accounts” tab. Fields to be displayed shall include userID, full name, appointment, Unit/Department, Ministry/Agency, roles assigned, last login date. b. c. “Suspended Accounts” tab. Fields to be displayed shall include the userID, full name, appointment, Unit/Department, Ministry/Agency, roles assigned, last login date, account suspended date, remarks. Remarks should indicate why the account was suspended, e.g. due to inactivity for more than 90 days. “Removed Accounts” tab. Fields to be displayed shall include userID, full name, appointment, Unit/Department, Ministry/Agency, roles assigned, last login date, account removal date, remarks. Remarks should indicate why the account was deleted, e.g. due to inactivity for more than 180 days; change in unit.

20.1.4 Account Reviewer shall be able to click into the account and the system shall display the detailed information of the user (i.e. full name, appointment, department, email addresses, remarks, role assignment, ReqCen assignment, etc).

20.1.5 In each tab, by default, system shall list all accounts pending review, i.e. “Pending Verification” list. Upon Account Reviewer selection of the users by clicking on the respective checkbox, it shall allow Account Reviewer to choose "Verify" or "Remove" of the selected records. Upon choosing “Verify", the verified account shall be listed on "Verified" list. Upon choosing "Remove", the removed account shall be listed on "Removed" list. A "Select All" button shall be included in each page so that Account Reviewer can apply "Verify" or "Remove" to all the selected records.
20.1.6 Account Reviewer shall only be allowed to complete the task when all the accounts listed in the task are reviewed.

20.1.7 When the Account Review module is launched, system shall display a summary of all account review tasks and also shows basic information of each task, e.g. review status (e.g. open, completed), task start date, task due date, completed on, completed by. When reviewer clicks on each task, it should display information of all accounts included in the task.
20.1.8 Within each task, system shall provide an option for Account Reviewer to export all the records within the task.
20.1.9 The overall layout of the summary shall be similar to that for log review module.

title: Monthly User Account Review
acceptance_criteria: 20.2.1 System shall send user an email notification to inform users to review his/her account. The contents in the email shall state the deadline to complete the review, typically within 21 calendar days. The duration shall be easily configurable using site properties or other suitable means.

20.2.2 Informed users shall login to CRIPS to confirm if he/she still requires the user account in his/her current appointment. If he/she clicks ‘Yes’, the account shall be maintained as active. If he/she clicks ‘No’, system shall delete the account immediately.

20.2.3 System shall send a reminder via email notification to inform users to review his/her account if he/she has not done so after 14 calendar days. The duration shall be easily configurable using site properties or other suitable means. The contents in the email shall remind him/her of the required actions and also state the deadline to complete the review.

20.2.4 System shall suspend the user of his/her account if he/she does not do review his/her account by the stipulated deadline. He/She will receive an email to inform his/her has been suspended as the review was not done. Administrator shall be able to toggle the account from ‘Suspended’ to ‘Active’.

title: De-provision user accounts
acceptance_criteria: 20.3.1 For users who did not complete the required account review by the stipulated deadline, system shall suspend his/her account and send him/her an email notification to inform the account is suspended as review was not done. OFFICIAL (CLOSED) OFFICIAL (CLOSED)

20.3.2 For user who is a MINDEF/SAF personnel, system shall check the records in EIMS/EAD to verify his/her term of services or employment status. If he/she is no longer working in MINDEF/SAF, the user account shall be deleted automatically and immediately.
20.3.3 Upon expiry of CR requisition plans raised by ReqCens, system shall delete their EMA accounts automatically on the following day. 21. LOG REVIEWER USER STORY

title: Review Logs
acceptance_criteria: 21.1.1 System shall generate a task at the start of each week and set the due date for completion to be within 7 working days. System shall allow changes in review frequency or completion timeline so as to adhere to the latest policy, e.g. changing completion timeline, e.g. from 7 working days to 14 calendar days. System shall allow such changes to be implemented easily, e.g. via changes to site properties.
21.1.2 System shall generate an email to inform Log Reviewer of a task pending his/her action.

21.1.3 System shall categorise the logs into “Compensation Rates”, “User Accounts”, “Failed Login” and “Failed Validation”. When reviewing, system shall display all logs including the Reviewer’s logs. Log Reviewer must not be allowed to review his/her own logs. However, his/her logs must still be reviewed, i.e. by another Log Reviewer. a. 21.1.4 “Compensation Rates” tab. Fields to be displayed shall include CR Category, CR Type, rate type (e.g. hourly with undertakings), old value, new value, modified by, modified on (date and time). b. “User Accounts” tab. Fields to be displayed shall include the userID, full name, Ministry/Agency/Unit, role, action (add/remove), modified by, modified on (date and time). c. “Failed Login” tab. Fields to be displayed shall include userID, full name, appointment, Ministry/Agency/Unit, message, log created on (date and time). Message shall indicate why the log was recorded, e.g. invalid user. d. “Failed Validation” tab. Fields to be displayed shall include userID, full name, Unit/Department, Ministry/Agency, screen, message, modified on (date and time). Screen field shall indicate where the validation failed, e.g. Service Acceptance Details. Message field shall indicate what is the failed validation, e.g. accepted quantity cannot exceed the available limit. In each tab, by default, system shall list all logs pending review, i.e. “Pending Verification” list. Upon Log Reviewer selection of the logs by clicking on the respective checkbox, it shall allow Log Reviewer to choose "Verify" of the selected records. Upon choosing “Verify", the verified logs shall be listed on "Verified" list. OFFICIAL (CLOSED) OFFICIAL (CLOSED)
21.1.5 A "Select All" button shall be included in each page so that Log Reviewer can apply "Verify" to all the selected records.
21.1.6 Log Reviewer shall only be allowed to complete the task when all the logs listed in the task are reviewed.

21.1.7 When the Log Review module is launched, system shall display a summary of all log review tasks and also show basic information of each task, e.g. review status (e.g. open, completed), task start date, task due date, completed on, completed by.
21.1.8 When reviewer clicks on each task, it should display information of all logs included in the task.

title: Learning and Sharing
acceptance_criteria: 22.1.1 Chief Controller Office, Controllers, CROs and Administrators shall be allowed to upload files. After he/she has attached the file and upon clicking on the ‘Save’ button, system shall require him/her to acknowledge: a. The document classification is ‘Restricted’ or below.
22.1.2 b. He/She has scanned the file(s) and it does not contain any malware.
22.1.3 Chief Controller Office, Controllers, CROs and Administrators shall be allowed to housekeep the documents (e.g. delete outdated materials) in the Learning and Sharing module.
22.1.4 System shall show the date/time the documents are published in the Learning and Sharing module.
22.1.5 Users shall be able to download the documents available in the Learning and Sharing module.
22.1.6 Users shall be able to search using keywords. The search shall also be able to search keywords within documents available in the Learning and Sharing module.
